answer.text: Time horizon + priority + liquidity need (e.g., short-term emergency vs long-term retirement)

explanation.text: The Logic: Goals are recorded with priority, time frame and funds needed; liquidity needs are separately assessed as an investment constraint. The Trap: Single-axis frameworks (risk-only, asset-class-only, return-only) miss the goal-priority and liquidity dimensions. Note: Source: NISM-Series-XXI-B Portfolio Managers workbook, p.166, p.168-169.
